sentences.en: Your mother must have been beautiful when she was young.
sentences.zh: 你妈妈年轻的时候一定很漂亮。

sentences.en: Mother advised me to take a walk for a change.
sentences.zh: 妈妈建议我换换环境去散散步。

sentences.en: On arriving at the station, she rang up her mother.
sentences.zh: 到了车站后，她给妈妈打了电话。

senses.zh: 母亲；大娘；女修道院院长
生下；养育；像母亲般关怀或照管
